recent.text: Spencer Carbery declined to answer whether Logan Thompson or Charlie Lindgren will start tomorrow in Boston. Acknowledged that when a goalie is struggling, sometimes you want to get him back on the horse, but sometimes he needs to take a break. TBD which approach will prevail.
recent.author: Katie Adler

recent.text: Vincent Desharnais (appendectomy) will not be ready to play tomorrow, per Spencer Carbery, but returning as a full participant in practice is a good sign. Carbery didn't think there was concern about Cole Hutson (maintenance), though he'll have to check with the training staff.
recent.author: RMNB

recent.text: Spencer Carbery says getting Vincent Desharnais back in a normal jersey is a good sign, but confirms he won't play vs. Boston tomorrow. Carbery didn't sound too concerned about Cole Hutson (maintenance), though he'll have to check with the training staff.
recent.author: Katie Adler

recent.text: Carbery wouldn't commit to his starter for tomorrow, so remains to be seen whether Logan Thompson or Charlie Lindgren will go against Boston.

recent.text: Carbery wouldn't talk about whether Logan Thompson or Charlie Lindgren will start tomorrow in Boston. He acknowledged that letting Thompson play through his struggles or taking some time to reset are things to consider. I guess we'll see what they decide tomorrow.

recent.text: Caps coach Spencer Carbery said he didn't have any concern about Cole Hutson (maintenance day), playing tomorrow in Boston, but would talk to trainer. Carbery said good step for Vincent Desharnais shedding the non-contact jersey today, but he won't play play tomorrow.
